subject: nist-genai-profile-comment-clauses

specific_clauses_to_comment: GOVERN 1.2: Add requirement for signed measurement as evidence of compliance
MAP 2.1: Add requirement for anchored proof of when measurement was known
MEASURE 2.4: Replace binary compliance verdict with three-state (MEASURED/UNMEASURED/PENDING)
MANAGE 4.1: Add corrections ledger as requirement for honesty infrastructure
metrics.rationale: Existing AI RMF is framework/taxonomy only. Adding measurement infrastructure requirements closes the gap between policy and verifiable evidence.
metrics.cross_reference: Aligns with NIST AI RMF 1.0 (Jan 2023) and supplementary guides through 2025

honest_sentence: NIST GenAI Profile specific clauses to comment: GOVERN 1.2 (signed evidence), MAP 2.1 (anchored proof of when known), MEASURE 2.4 (three-state verdicts), MANAGE 4.1 (corrections ledger). Closes framework/taxonomy-only gap.
